command: local c='0'; local n=0; local h=0; local b=0; local g={identity=0,checkpoint=0,generation=0,epoch=0,other=0}; repeat local r=redis.call('SCAN',c,'COUNT',1000); c=r[1]; for _,k in ipairs(r[2]) do n=n+1; local t=redis.call('TYPE',k).ok; if t=='hash' then h=h+1; b=math.max(b,redis.call('HSTRLEN',k,'data')) end; if string.find(k,'shared-identity-v1:',1,true)==1 then g.identity=g.identity+1 elseif string.find(k,'shared-checkpoint:',1,true)==1 then g.checkpoint=g.checkpoint+1 elseif string.find(k,'shared-generation:',1,true)==1 then g.generation=g.generation+1 elseif string.find(k,'shared-epoch:',1,true)==1 then g.epoch=g.epoch+1 else g.other=g.other+1 end end until c=='0'; return cjson.encode({total_keys=n,hash_values=h,maximum_hash_data_bytes=b,groups=g})
